payload.name: pc-check-mode
payload.description: Raw validator that accepts only the exact strings 'eco' or 'boost' (case-sensitive, no normalization) and returns {accepted, mode} where mode is the original string when accepted and null otherwise. Pure logic; no imports, host calls, I/O or coercion. Reads the raw candidate with inputs.get so missing and null are both reported as not accepted rather than raising.
